brands.name: Chanel
brands.description: Parisian house founded by Gabrielle Chanel, defining modern women's luxury.

directors.name: Gabrielle Chanel
directors.bio: Founder of the house; established the codes of tweed, camellia, and the little black dress.

directors.name: Karl Lagerfeld
directors.bio: Revived and modernized Chanel for over three decades until his death.

directors.name: Virginie Viard
directors.bio: Longtime Lagerfeld collaborator who succeeded him as head of creative.

directors.name: Matthieu Blazy
directors.bio: Former Bottega Veneta creative director appointed to lead Chanel.

brands.name: Dior
brands.description: Legendary Paris couture house known for the New Look and romantic femininity.

directors.name: Christian Dior
directors.bio: Founded the house and introduced the New Look silhouette.

directors.name: Yves Saint Laurent
directors.bio: Succeeded Dior at age 21 before founding his own house.

directors.name: Marc Bohan
directors.bio: Longest-serving Dior designer, known for refined daywear and evening glamour.

directors.name: Gianfranco Ferré
directors.bio: Italian architect-designer who brought structured elegance to Dior.

directors.name: John Galliano
directors.bio: Theatrical couturier who redefined Dior's romantic drama.

directors.name: Raf Simons
directors.bio: Minimalist Belgian designer who streamlined Dior's silhouette.

directors.name: Maria Grazia Chiuri
directors.bio: First woman to lead Dior; known for feminist messaging and bohemian romance.

brands.name: Louis Vuitton
brands.description: World's leading luxury brand, part of LVMH, spanning leather goods, ready-to-wear, and travel.

directors.name: Marc Jacobs
directors.bio: Introduced ready-to-wear and transformed LV into a fashion powerhouse.

directors.name: Nicolas Ghesquière
directors.bio: Former Balenciaga designer known for futuristic sport-luxe at Louis Vuitton.

directors.name: Pharrell Williams
directors.bio: Musician and designer appointed to lead Louis Vuitton menswear.

brands.name: Gucci
brands.description: Florentine house famed for Italian craft, bold branding, and maximalist reinvention.

directors.name: Tom Ford
directors.bio: Revived Gucci with sensual, jet-set glamour.

directors.name: Frida Giannini
directors.bio: Expanded Gucci's heritage motifs and accessories focus.

directors.name: Alessandro Michele
directors.bio: Defined Gucci's eclectic, gender-fluid maximalist era.

directors.name: Sabato De Sarno
directors.bio: Former Valentino designer who pursued a cleaner, sensual minimalism.

directors.name: Demna
directors.bio: Balenciaga creative director appointed to lead Gucci.

brands.name: Prada
brands.description: Milanese house blending intellectual design, nylon innovation, and Miuccia Prada's vision.

directors.name: Miuccia Prada
directors.bio: Transformed Prada into a global fashion authority alongside Raf Simons since 2020.

directors.name: Raf Simons
directors.bio: Shared creative leadership with Miuccia Prada until his departure.

brands.name: Hermès
brands.description: Parisian maison renowned for craftsmanship, equestrian heritage, and leather excellence.

directors.name: Jean Paul Gaultier
directors.bio: Brought playful couture spirit to Hermès womenswear.

directors.name: Christophe Lemaire
directors.bio: Known for quiet luxury and refined minimal silhouettes.

directors.name: Nadège Vanhee-Cybulski
directors.bio: Former Celine designer leading Hermès women's ready-to-wear and leather.

directors.name: Véronique Nichanian
directors.bio: Long-serving menswear director known for understated tailoring.

brands.name: Balenciaga
brands.description: House founded by Cristóbal Balenciaga, later reinvented through avant-garde street-luxe.

directors.name: Cristóbal Balenciaga
directors.bio: Master couturier whose sculptural volumes influenced modern fashion.

directors.name: Nicolas Ghesquière
directors.bio: Futuristic designer who rebuilt Balenciaga's relevance.

directors.name: Alexander Wang
directors.bio: Short tenure bridging downtown New York energy with the house.

directors.name: Demna
directors.bio: Vetements founder who reshaped luxury through irony and oversize silhouettes.

directors.name: Pierpaolo Piccioli
directors.bio: Former Valentino co-creative director appointed to lead Balenciaga.

brands.name: Saint Laurent
brands.description: Yves Saint Laurent's house, defining Le Smoking, Rive Gauche, and Parisian cool.

directors.name: Yves Saint Laurent
directors.bio: Revolutionized women's wardrobes with androgyny and prêt-à-porter.

directors.name: Stefano Pilati
directors.bio: Refined the house with strong shoulders and Parisian tailoring.

directors.name: Hedi Slimane
directors.bio: Rebranded to Saint Laurent Paris with rock-and-roll skinny silhouettes.

directors.name: Anthony Vaccarello
directors.bio: Known for body-conscious glamour and strong red-carpet dressing.

brands.name: Bottega Veneta
brands.description: Venetian house famous for intrecciato leather and quiet luxury under recent creative leaders.

directors.name: Tomas Maier
directors.bio: Championed stealth wealth and artisanal leather goods.

directors.name: Daniel Lee
directors.bio: Revived the brand with puff shoes, vibrant leather, and the Cassette bag.

directors.name: Matthieu Blazy
directors.bio: Known for effortless luxury and viral celebrity moments before moving to Chanel.

directors.name: Louise Trotter
directors.bio: Former Carven and Joseph designer appointed to succeed Matthieu Blazy.

brands.name: Burberry
brands.description: British heritage brand known for trench coats, check patterns, and rainwear.

directors.name: Christopher Bailey
directors.bio: Modernized Burberry with digital innovation and streamlined luxury.

directors.name: Riccardo Tisci
directors.bio: Former Givenchy designer who introduced the TB monogram era.

directors.name: Daniel Lee
directors.bio: Returned to a British craft-focused vision with playful color and knitwear.

brands.name: Versace
brands.description: Milanese house defined by bold prints, Medusa iconography, and glamour.

directors.name: Gianni Versace
directors.bio: Created the house's signature sexy, baroque aesthetic.

directors.name: Donatella Versace
directors.bio: Sister of Gianni who steered Versace for nearly three decades.

directors.name: Pieter Mulier
directors.bio: Former Alaïa creative director appointed to lead Versace.

brands.name: Valentino
brands.description: Roman couture house celebrated for red gowns and romantic elegance.

directors.name: Valentino Garavani
directors.bio: Defined Valentino red and red-carpet glamour.

directors.name: Alessandra Facchinetti
directors.bio: Brief tenure following Valentino's retirement.

directors.name: Maria Grazia Chiuri
directors.bio: Co-led with Pierpaolo Piccioli before departing for Dior.

directors.name: Pierpaolo Piccioli
directors.bio: Solo creative director after Chiuri's exit; known for poetic couture.

directors.name: Alessandro Michele
directors.bio: Former Gucci creative director appointed to Valentino.

brands.name: Givenchy
brands.description: Paris house founded by Hubert de Givenchy, long associated with Audrey Hepburn's elegance.

directors.name: Hubert de Givenchy
directors.bio: Created refined Parisian couture and the Audrey Hepburn relationship.

directors.name: John Galliano
directors.bio: Short tenure before moving to Dior.

directors.name: Alexander McQueen
directors.bio: Provocative British talent before founding his eponymous label's peak era.

directors.name: Riccardo Tisci
directors.bio: Introduced dark romanticism and streetwear collaborations.

directors.name: Clare Waight Keller
directors.bio: First woman to lead Givenchy; designed Meghan Markle's wedding dress.

directors.name: Matthew M. Williams
directors.bio: 1017 ALYX 9SM founder who brought hardware-heavy utility to Givenchy.

directors.name: Sarah Burton
directors.bio: Former Alexander McQueen right hand appointed to lead Givenchy.

brands.name: Fendi
brands.description: Roman fur and leather house, part of LVMH, known for Baguette bags and Roman craft.

directors.name: Karl Lagerfeld
directors.bio: Five-decade collaboration that defined Fendi's modern identity.

directors.name: Silvia Venturini Fendi
directors.bio: Third-generation Fendi family member overseeing accessories and menswear.

directors.name: Kim Jones
directors.bio: Shared creative leadership for womenswear, menswear, and couture fur.

brands.name: Loewe
brands.description: Spanish leather house under LVMH, celebrated for craft, art collaborations, and puzzle bags.

directors.name: Stuart Vevers
directors.bio: Introduced a younger luxury leather goods direction.

directors.name: Jonathan Anderson
directors.bio: Transformed Loewe into a cultural fashion leader with craft and surrealism.

directors.name: TBD
directors.bio: Successor to Jonathan Anderson pending announcement.

brands.name: Celine
brands.description: Parisian house known for understated chic, triomphe logo, and Phoebe Philo-era minimalism.

directors.name: Michael Kors
directors.bio: Early tenure before building his American brand.

directors.name: Ivana Omazic
directors.bio: Former Prada designer who refined Celine's clean lines.

directors.name: Phoebe Philo
directors.bio: Defined modern minimal Celine with the Luggage and Phantom bags.

directors.name: Hedi Slimane
directors.bio: Reintroduced rock aesthetic and youth-driven branding to Celine.

directors.name: Michael Rider
directors.bio: Former Celine design director returning to lead the house.

brands.name: Miu Miu
brands.description: Prada Group's playful sister label exploring subversive femininity and youth culture.

directors.name: Miuccia Prada
directors.bio: Founded Miu Miu as an experimental counterpart to Prada.

brands.name: Tom Ford
brands.description: American brand founded by the designer after Gucci and YSL, known for glamour and sex appeal.

directors.name: Tom Ford
directors.bio: Led his namesake label until its acquisition by Estée Lauder Companies.

directors.name: Peter Hawkings
directors.bio: Longtime Tom Ford collaborator appointed to succeed the founder.

brands.name: Alexander McQueen
brands.description: British house founded by Lee Alexander McQueen, known for dramatic tailoring and showmanship.

directors.name: Lee Alexander McQueen
directors.bio: Visionary designer whose shows redefined fashion spectacle.

directors.name: Sarah Burton
directors.bio: McQueen protégée who designed Kate Middleton's wedding gown.

directors.name: Sean McGirr
directors.bio: Former JW Anderson designer appointed to lead Alexander McQueen.

brands.name: Jacquemus
brands.description: Independent French label known for Provence-inspired minimalism and viral accessories.

directors.name: Simon Porte Jacquemus
directors.bio: Self-taught designer who built Jacquemus into a global contemporary brand.

brands.name: Alaïa
brands.description: Paris house founded by Azzedine Alaïa, celebrated for body-conscious sculptural knits.

directors.name: Azzedine Alaïa
directors.bio: Master of fit who worked directly on the body like sculpture.

directors.name: Pieter Mulier
directors.bio: Former Raf Simons collaborator who revived Alaïa's couture spirit.

directors.name: TBD
directors.bio: Vacant following Pieter Mulier's departure for Versace.

brands.name: Moschino
brands.description: Milanese label founded by Franco Moschino, defined by irony, pop culture, and humor.

directors.name: Franco Moschino
directors.bio: Pioneer of witty, subversive Italian fashion.

directors.name: Rossella Jardini
directors.bio: Longtime collaborator who preserved Moschino's playful DNA.

directors.name: Jeremy Scott
directors.bio: American designer who amplified cartoonish pop maximalism.

directors.name: Adrian Appiolaza
directors.bio: Former Prada designer who refined Moschino's archival references.

directors.name: Loris Messina & Simone Rizzo
directors.bio: Sunnei founders appointed as co-creative directors of Moschino.

brands.name: Armani
brands.description: Giorgio Armani's Milanese empire spanning couture, ready-to-wear, and lifestyle lines.

directors.name: Giorgio Armani
directors.bio: Defined power dressing and Italian soft tailoring for half a century.

directors.name: Leo Maria Prezioso
directors.bio: Appointed to lead Giorgio Armani following the founder's passing.

brands.name: Dolce & Gabbana
brands.description: Sicilian duo's house celebrating Mediterranean femininity, corsetry, and baroque excess.

directors.name: Domenico Dolce
directors.bio: Co-founder who continues to lead creative direction alongside Stefano Gabbana.

directors.name: Stefano Gabbana
directors.bio: Co-founder and public face of the brand's bold Italian aesthetic.

brands.name: Moncler
brands.description: Alpine outerwear brand evolved into a luxury fashion group with Genius collaborations.

directors.name: Remo Ruffini
directors.bio: Acquired and transformed Moncler; oversees creative strategy and Moncler Genius.

directors.name: Pierpaolo Piccioli
directors.bio: Led a Moncler Genius chapter before returning to full-time house roles.
